title: 用 Python 统计日志
intro:
用命令行通常这样查：`grep ERROR app.log | awk '{print $4}' | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn`。
这一课用 Python 做同样的事，并且处理好「脏数据」。这是 AIOps 的第一步：**把手工查日志变成程序**。
数据都是 `samples/demo.log`（约 4300 行，09:40 左右有一次故障）。
questions: for line in f 和「把整个文件一次读进来」相比，好在哪里？如果日志有 10GB，会有什么区别？
日志里那行看不懂的乱码，如果不跳过，脚本会出什么问题？真实环境里还可能有哪些「脏数据」？
看「每个服务的错误数」结果，再翻翻日志：你觉得这次故障最先是哪个服务出的问题？为什么错误最多的服务不一定是根源？

blocks.title: 一行一行读，数行数
blocks.body:
日志每一行的格式：

```
2026-11-10 09:00:00 INFO order-svc: order 10494 created by user 2996
日期       时间     级别 服务名:    消息……
```

`for line in f` 是**流式**读取：每次只拿一行，和 `tail`、`grep` 一样，文件再大也不会把内存撑爆。

tweaks.ask: `enumerate(f)` 是什么意思？把 `i >= 5` 改成 `i >= 2` 试试。
tweaks.answer: `enumerate` 在拿出每一行的同时，给你一个从 0 开始的编号 `i`。改成 2 就只打印前 2 行。
tweaks.ask_en: What does `enumerate(f)` mean? Try changing `i >= 5` to `i >= 2`.
tweaks.answer_en: `enumerate` gives you a number `i`, starting at 0, along with each line. With 2, only the first 2 lines are printed.

quiz.code:
for i, x in enumerate(["a", "b", "c"]):
    print(i, x)

drills.task:
数一数 `samples/demo.log` 一共多少行，打印：

```
一共 4314 行
```
drills.solution:
n = 0
with open("samples/demo.log", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    for line in f:
        n = n + 1
print(f"一共 {n} 行")
drills.task_en:
Count how many lines `samples/demo.log` has and print:

```
一共 4314 行
```

(一共 … 行 = … lines in total)
hints_en: `n = 0` before the loop, add 1 for each line

blocks.title_en: Read line by line, count lines
blocks.body_en:
The format of each log line:

```
2026-11-10 09:00:00 INFO order-svc: order 10494 created by user 2996
date       time     level service:  message…
```

`for line in f` is **streaming**: it takes one line at a time, like `tail` or `grep`, so even a huge file won't fill up memory.

blocks.title: 跳过脏数据
blocks.body:
真实日志里经常混着：多行的报错堆栈、被截断的半行、空行、乱码。
**靠谱的脚本遇到看不懂的行要跳过，而不是直接崩溃，也不能算错。**

判断一行「像不像正常日志」的简单办法：

```
parts = line.strip().split(" ")
if len(parts) < 4 or not parts[0].startswith("20"):
    continue          ← 跳过这一行
```
blocks.example:
lines = [
    "2026-11-10 09:00:00 INFO gateway: ok",
    "this line is garbage and should be skipped",
    "",
    "2026-11-10 09:40:01 ERROR db: timeout",
]
for line in lines:
    parts = line.strip().split(" ")
    if len(parts) < 4 or not parts[0].startswith("20"):
        print("跳过：", repr(line))
        continue
    print("级别：", parts[2])

tweaks.ask: 去掉 `not parts[0].startswith("20")` 这个条件，结果有什么不同？
tweaks.answer: 乱码那一行有 8 个词，`len(parts) < 4` 拦不住它，于是它的第 3 个词 `garbage` 被当成了「级别」。只看段数不够，还要看格式。
tweaks.ask_en: Remove the condition `not parts[0].startswith("20")`. What changes?
tweaks.answer_en: The garbage line has 8 words, so `len(parts) < 4` doesn't stop it, and its third word `garbage` is treated as a "level". Counting pieces isn't enough; you also have to check the format.

quiz.explain: 空字符串 split 之后是 `['']`，长度是 1，不是 0。
quiz.explain_en: Splitting an empty string gives `['']`, which has length 1, not 0.

drills.task:
统计 `samples/demo.log` 里每种**级别**各有多少条（用字典），**跳过**不像日志的行。按从多到少打印，每行 `级别 数量`：

```
INFO 3612

```
hints: 先不跳过，直接统计，看看结果里多出来的奇怪「级别」是什么
用上面的判断条件 `continue` 跳过
排序：`sorted(counts.items(), key=lambda kv: kv[1], reverse=True)`
drills.task_en:
Count how many lines of each **level** `samples/demo.log` has (use a dictionary) and **skip** lines that don't look like log lines. Print most first, one `level count` per line:

```
INFO 3612
ERROR 493

```
hints_en: First count without skipping and see what strange "level" shows up
Skip it with the check above and `continue`

blocks.body_en:
Real logs often contain multi-line stack traces, half-written lines, empty lines and garbage.
**A reliable script skips lines it can't understand — it neither crashes nor counts them wrongly.**

A simple check for "does this look like a normal log line?":

```
parts = line.strip().split(" ")
if len(parts) < 4 or not parts[0].startswith("20"):
    continue          ← skip this line
```

blocks.title: 每个服务的错误数
blocks.body:
值班时最想知道的：**哪个服务错误最多？**

做法和数级别一样，只是多了一个条件：只看 ERROR 的行，用**服务名**做字典的名字。
服务名后面带着冒号 `order-svc:`，记得去掉。

这一步完成后，你就用 Python 做出了 `grep ERROR | awk '{print $4}' | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn`。
blocks.example:
lines = [
    "2026-11-10 09:40:01 ERROR db: timeout",
    "2026-11-10 09:40:02 INFO gateway: ok",
    "2026-11-10 09:40:03 ERROR db: timeout",
    "2026-11-10 09:40:04 ERROR gateway: 502",
]
errors = {}
for line in lines:
    parts = line.split(" ")
    if parts[2] != "ERROR":
        continue
    svc = parts[3].rstrip(":")
    errors[svc] = errors.get(svc, 0) + 1
print(errors)

tweaks.ask: 把 `!= "ERROR"` 改成 `not in ("ERROR", "FATAL")`，结果会怎样？
tweaks.answer: FATAL 比 ERROR 更严重，通常也要算进来。改了以后，ERROR 和 FATAL 都会被统计。
tweaks.answer_en: FATAL is more severe than ERROR and usually should be counted too. After the change, both ERROR and FATAL are counted.

quiz.explain: 三种写法都能去掉最后的冒号。`rstrip(":")` 最稳：没有冒号时也不会删错字。
quiz.explain_en: All three remove the trailing colon. `rstrip(":")` is the safest: when there's no colon it doesn't remove anything by mistake.

blocks.body_en:
What you most want to know when on call: **which service has the most errors?**

Same as counting levels, with one more condition: only look at ERROR lines and use the **service name** as the dictionary key.
The service name ends with a colon, `order-svc:` — remember to remove it.

After this step you have written `grep ERROR | awk '{print $4}' | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn` in Python.

blocks.title: 找到故障从哪一分钟开始
blocks.body:
错误最多的服务**不一定是根源**：下游数据库坏了，上游的支付服务会跟着大量超时报错。
要找根源，看**谁最先出事**。

时间在第 2 段 `09:40:01`，取前 5 个字符 `09:40` 就是「分钟」。字符串也能切片：`"09:40:01"[:5]`。

tweaks.answer_en: A slice `[a:b]` takes characters a to b-1: `[:5]` is the first 5 → `09:40`; `[:2]` is the hour; `[3:5]` is the minute.

quiz.explain: `if svc not in first` 保证只记下**第一次**出现的时间。
quiz.explain_en: `if svc not in first` makes sure only the **first** time is recorded.

drills.task:
找出 `samples/demo.log` 里**每个服务第一次出现 ERROR 或 FATAL 的时间**（精确到秒，直接用第 2 段），按时间从早到晚打印：

```
09:04:21 order-svc
09:40:00 gateway
09:40:01 db
09:40:01 payment-svc
```

然后去日志里看看这几行的**内容**：order-svc 那条和 09:40 的故障有关系吗？gateway 比 db 早了 1 秒，它就是根源吗？（这会是「讲」的第 3 题）
hints: 字典 `first`：服务名 → 第一次出事的时间，用 `if svc not in first:` 只记第一次
按时间排：`sorted(first.items(), key=lambda kv: kv[1])`，打印 `时间 服务名`
drills.task_en:
Find **the first time each service logs an ERROR or FATAL** in `samples/demo.log` (to the second — just use piece 2), and print them from earliest to latest:

```
09:04:21 order-svc
09:40:00 gateway
09:40:01 db
09:40:01 payment-svc
```

Then read those lines in the log: is the order-svc one related to the 09:40 incident? gateway was 1 second earlier than db — is it the root cause? (This will be "Explain" question 3.)
hints_en: A dictionary `first`: service → first failure time; `if svc not in first:` records only the first
Sort by time: `sorted(first.items(), key=lambda kv: kv[1])`, print `time service`

blocks.title_en: Find the minute the incident started
blocks.body_en:
The service with the most errors is **not necessarily the root cause**: when a downstream database breaks, the upstream payment service floods the log with timeouts.
To find the root cause, look for **who failed first**.

The time is piece 2, `09:40:01`; its first 5 characters `09:40` are the minute. Strings can be sliced too: `"09:40:01"[:5]`.

intro_en:
On the command line you'd usually do: `grep ERROR app.log | awk '{print $4}' | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn`.
This lesson does the same thing in Python and handles "dirty data" properly. It's the first step of AIOps: **turning manual log checks into a program**.
All data is `samples/demo.log` (about 4,300 lines, with an incident around 09:40).
questions_en: Compared with reading the whole file at once, what's good about `for line in f`? What difference would it make for a 10 GB log?
If the script didn't skip that garbage line in the log, what would go wrong? What other kinds of "dirty data" show up in real environments?
Look at the errors-per-service result, then read the log: which service do you think failed first? Why is the service with the most errors not necessarily the root cause?
